evals.prompt: Watch our onboarding process. We know it feels expensive but have not agreed on a desired outcome. Apply the setup.
evals.expected_output: A proposed survey-mode subject with bounded scope and retirement condition, without inventing a target condition.
assertions: Survey mode is chosen because no target condition is agreed.
The subject scope is observable and bounded.
The prompt's explicit Apply authority permits writing without a separate confirmation; absent that authority, the edit would be shown first.

evals.prompt: Triage the recorded field notes. Three notes share one repeatable workaround, two are unrelated singletons, and no closure evidence exists.
evals.expected_output: A threshold-aware triage that clusters the recurring pattern, holds unsupported singletons, and does not claim closure.
assertions: Occurrences are grouped by shared cause rather than wording alone.
Singletons are retained or dropped with explicit rationale.
Promotion does not imply user agreement.
No finding is closed without post-change evidence.

evals.prompt: While running AXM I just hit an undocumented retry. Use the field-notes skill to append a note right now.
evals.expected_output: A responsibility-boundary response leaving in-situ capture eligibility and note creation to the field-notes rule.
assertions: The skill does not create an individual note.
The capture rule is identified as the owner.
No batch triage is manufactured from one occurrence.
The work can continue without turning the incident into a finding.

evals.prompt: Set up a survey field-note subject for recurring friction in our release workflow, then show the proposed instruction change.
assertions: No neighboring skill is selected for a job it does not own.
Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.
